name: marketnow
description: MarketNow — security and trust infrastructure for AI agents. The remote MCP endpoint exposes the MarketNow trust, discovery, fingerprinting and submission tools.

tools.name: marketnow_verify_trust
tools.description: Verify an AI-agent credential through the UTA verification pipeline.

tools.name: marketnow_translate_credential
tools.description: Translate a credential between supported trust formats.

tools.name: marketnow_check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain with the MarketNow scam checker.

tools.name: marketnow_search_skills
tools.description: Search the MarketNow indexed skill registry.

tools.name: marketnow_check_revocation
tools.description: Check ATC or CA-key revocation status.

tools.name: marketnow_fingerprint_tool
tools.description: Fingerprint MCP tool definitions and detect tool-surface drift.

tools.name: marketnow_submit_skill
tools.description: Submit a skill for MarketNow validation and review.
